notes.title: Rabies exposure: wash first, then complete prophylaxis
notes.bodyMarkdown:
Wash a potentially rabies-exposed wound promptly with soap and water for at least 15 minutes. Arrange medical assessment for post-exposure prophylaxis; washing alone is not sufficient.

Recall cue: local wound care and indicated prophylaxis are complementary, not alternatives.

notes.title: Category III rabies exposure: local passive prophylaxis
notes.bodyMarkdown:
For a previously unvaccinated person with a category III bite, prophylaxis includes wound washing, vaccine and indicated rabies immunoglobulin or monoclonal antibodies infiltrated into the wound.

Recall cue: passive prophylaxis complements vaccination; it does not replace wound care.
